definitions.gloss: last departure; last service (train, bus, flight, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The final scheduled departure of a train, bus, or other transport for the day. The opposite of {始発|しはつ} (first departure).

examples.japanese: {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is the last departure?

examples.japanese: {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I didn't make it in time for the last train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}いて→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧、{終発|しゅうはつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The drinking party dragged on, so I missed the last train and went home by taxi.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧ (first departure). While ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧ (last train) is more commonly used in everyday conversation for trains specifically, {終発|しゅうはつ} is the general term that applies to any mode of transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to catch the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to make it in time for the last departure
- {終発|しゅうはつ}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: last departure time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧: last train — specifically for electric trains; more common in everyday speech
- {終バス|しゅうばす}: last bus — specifically for buses
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧: first departure — the opposite; the first service of the day
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧: last; final — often used as ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ for the last flight
